title: Monthly options expiration (November)
source: OCC: theocc.com expiration calendar — 3rd-Friday standard, checked 2026-08-18
notes: Standard monthly expiration — the 3rd-Friday cycle, not the quarterly triple-witching (that is 2026-12-18). AMENDED 2026-09-09 by this event's own pulse check, which measured and withdrew the initial research's headline: the 2026-08-19 row called this the quietest of the four tracked opex cycles, sitting in a 'comparatively empty near-term calendar'. It is not. On 2026-08-19 the whole tracked November 2026 calendar was three events with an empty five-day corridor; it now holds 70, with 28 inside the corridor, impact-weighted 43 against the December year-end witching's 37 — the second-densest of the four and the heavier of the two. Read that as a measurement of our own coverage rather than of November: nothing about the month changed, the calendar did. The corridor is front-loaded (18 of 28 before the expiry), so the gamma cushion holds through retail-sales-2026-11-17, fomc-minutes-2026-11-18, apec-leaders-shenzhen-2026-11-18, treasury-20y-bond-2026-11-18 and treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19, then rolls off into a Thanksgiving-compressed week stacking pce-2026-11-25, gdp-q3-2026-second-2026-11-25, durable-goods-2026-11-25 and beige-book-2026-11-25 ahead of the 2026-11-26 closure. There is still no November FOMC decision (Oct 28, Dec 9), but the October minutes land two days before this expiry. The date gained an independent primary corroboration the same day: Cboe lists VX/V6 settling 2026-10-21, which under its own published rule is the Wednesday 30 days before November's third Friday — arithmetic that closes only on 2026-11-20. That contract's SOQ is built from THIS expiration's own SPX series and settles at 18.402 against VIX cash 15.72, the first quotable positioning number this ledger has carried. Impact stays MEDIUM and symbols stays empty: trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped 2026-09-09 for opex/expiration/witching/settlement/SOQ and return zero hits in both, so no house playbook is expiration-keyed. The call is stand aside at every horizon; a busier corridor widens caution and licenses nothing.
